needed.evidence: The footway on the right side is less than 1m wide and appears informal and unusable for safe pedestrian movement.
needed.suggestion: Install a continuous and wide (at least 1m) sidewalk on the right side to ensure pedestrian safety.

needed.evidence: The footway is partly blocked by obstructions that make it difficult for pedestrians to walk safely.
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions and maintain clear footway space on the right side to allow unobstructed pedestrian movement.

needed.evidence: There are uneven sections on the right footway that could cause pedestrians to trip.
needed.suggestion: Repair and smooth out uneven sections on the right footway to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: The marked pedestrian crossing is poorly visible and does not adequately ensure driver compliance.
needed.suggestion: Mark the crossing more clearly with additional signage and improve lighting to enhance visibility and ensure drivers stop for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: There are no kerb ramps at the crossing to assist pedestrians with mobility challenges.
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at both ends of the crossing to improve accessibility for all pedestrians.
